Overview

Lambaré is a city in CE with a population of 120,000. A suburb of Asunción, known for its hilly terrain and panoramic views of the capital. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. The population skews young, with a median age of 27.0.
